verdicts.note: Direction holds: the only safety-relevant evidence is professional formation, 15 years as a police officer and sergeant in patrol and detective units before law school [S1][S3]. But that is all there is. He has stated no bail, diversion or sentencing view, the policing career ended before his 2002 law degree, his 23 years of practice have been mostly civil, and his pro tem work (juvenile criminal, domestic-violence protection) is listed without any stated approach [S1][S3]. With no statement or record to corroborate it, placing him on the enforcement side is inference from a past career, which the guide rates low. The Spokane judicial safety scores kept at medium each paired formation with explicit statements (accountability pledges, therapeutic-court support); Chadwick has none.
